reading.title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
reading.summary: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.
